figurative_meaning_en: end of life or old age
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি জীবনসন্ধ্যায় পৌঁছে শান্তিতে দিন কাটাচ্ছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He spends his days peacefully in the twilight of his life.
It's pleasant to share memories in the sunset years.
note: This is a metaphorical expression rooted in natural imagery of day turning to evening, commonly used in Bengali literature to denote the later stages of life.
